text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since I started training Haru Urara.
I've gradually come to understand
a few things about her.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what huge footprints!
Whose footprints could they be?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"These footprints are way bigger than mine!
They must be really tall~!"
“—First of all, she gets bored very easily. Her lack of concentration likely stems from that personality trait. Furthermore...”

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, sorry about that!
Um, we were jogging, right!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Going for one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho, heave-ho...
"Whenever I scold her, she does seem to reflect on it, but..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff, whew!
Heft-ho, heft-ho, heft-ho...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? So lively!
Where, where? Where's the fun stuff?

...She immediately loses focus again
and runs off toward whatever looks more amusing.
At this rate, training won't have any effect.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Urara-san...!
Ditching training again!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"There it is, Urara's bad habit.
Wandering here, drifting there~."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I understand what you're trying to say.
Is there really nothing we can do about Urara-san's personality?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If training doesn't continue like that,
Urara-san is the only one who stands to lose.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You're worried about them?
King, you're so sweet~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Because she's like that even in the dorms.
Of course I'm worried about her...!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, Urara loves fun things! So she just heads toward whatever looks more interesting.

Apparently, Haru Urara's short attention span
is well-known among her classmates too.

...In order to come up with a countermeasure,
I need to learn more about Haru Urara.

Having spent my days thinking about that, my day off arrived.
When I went to the shopping district to buy groceries—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Step right up, step right up!
We've got super delicious apples here!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Sweet and packed with honey!
It's so good your cheeks'll melt right off! Care for some?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Care for an apple? Cheap and delicious!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup, that's right!
'Cause I loooove helping out!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, an acquaintance of Urara-chan's?
Well then, I've gotta throw in a little bonus for you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mister! You see this person here?
This is my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer...
Wait, Trainer?! U-Urara-chan's Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
H-Holy crap...!
Everyone, fall in! Gather around, now—!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
"—Well now, Urara-chan finally got
a Trainer of her own!
That's mighty fine news!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text: If you don't debut, you can't run in races, right? I was so worried~. But now, we can rest easy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you can count on me!
I'm gonna be running a whole lot from now on!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Urara-chan always gives us so much energy,
so the entire shopping district will be out cheering for her!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local D
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! She might be a bit clumsy,
but she's a really hard worker!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local E
text_block_list.text: Take good care of Urara-chan, alright?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you!

It seems Haru Urara is deeply loved by the folks in this shopping arcade.
I've learned yet another thing about her.

"—Afterward, telling me 'thanks for taking care
of our Urara-chan,' the shopping district folks
showered me with souvenirs..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you got so many!
I'll help you out!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's heavy, I'll be fine!
I just love helping out!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it really is heavy!
But I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho, heave-ho...

She carries luggage nearly half her height
with all her might...
She seems deeply focused.

"...How can I improve
Haru Urara's focus?
I've got a great idea!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh-?! Today's training is taking place
at the shopping street?
choice_data_list: This isn't training—this is a battle!
This isn't training, it's a real showdown!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh, a showdown!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Apple-carrying...? What's that, how do you play?

I asked the shopping district folks for their cooperation,
and came up with a "training in daily life" routine.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
—Mhm, mhm, so we're deciding who can
carry more apples faster!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: What's that? That sounds super fun! Yeah, count me in!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~!
I won't lose, you know!

Afterward, through training disguised as matches,
I was able to give her plenty of workouts.
It's sure to yield noticeable results.

Looks like I can keep training at this pace.
—I'll just turn a blind eye to the daily
onslaught of muscle soreness...
